item.text:
Enabled Cache Components and Partial Prefetching for the dashboard, with no route opt-outs. The shared project totals now use `use cache` in [projects.ts](/workspace/lib/projects.ts:1), while [page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx:5) reads each member’s name, team, and request region inside a Suspense boundary. The workspace heading and project counts remain visible while those details load.

`npm run build` passed. Next.js reports `/` as a partially prerendered route. Production requests for two different members returned their respective details with the same shared totals.
